title: Sieve form of local affine-cover vanishing
statement: Under the hypotheses of the cartesian higher-image construction, if an affine etale section of a stage cartesian higher image maps to zero in the limit, then there are a later stage and a covering sieve of the original object on which the transitioned section is zero.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.8, second proof; affine section reduction

proof.text: Lift the section to the cohomology presheaf, use local injectivity of sheafification to obtain a covering sieve on which the limit representative is zero, descend affine finitely presented objects to a common stage, and apply derived etale cohomology continuity. Naturality and exchange identify the resulting maps with the cartesian transition.

theorem cartesianHigherImage_affine_section_local_zero_sieve
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom] [∀ i, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget _).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (q : ℕ) (U : c.pt.left.Etale) [IsAffine U.left] (i : I)
    (x : (cartesianHigherImageStage D c f F q i).obj.obj (Opposite.op U))
    (hx : (cartesianHigherImageLeg D c f F q i).hom.app (Opposite.op U) x = 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (a : j ⟶ i) (S : Sieve U),
      S ∈ c.pt.left.smallEtaleTopology U ∧
      ∀ (V : c.pt.left.Etale) (r : V ⟶ U), S r →
        (cartesianHigherImageTransition D c f F q a).hom.app
          (Opposite.op V) ((cartesianHigherImageStage D c f F q i).obj.map r.op x) = 0
